source_duration.Closure or restriction episode: Venezuela–Colombia election restriction and San Antonio return, May 2025
source_duration.Movement / direction / phase: Ordinary pedestrian and vehicle passage at San Antonio’s principal customs access on the Venezuela–Colombia frontier during the May 2025 election restriction.
source_duration.Evidence basis: Migración Colombia records the Venezuelan order. The later La Nación report, republished by Primicia, describes actual ordinary vehicle and pedestrian return on 27 May after the halt beginning on 23 May, with the San Antonio barriers removed before 06:00.
source_duration.Qualification: Four calendar days to a scoped reported return, not 96 measured hours or proof that every frontier gate and traffic class stopped. The announced rule expired at 23:59 on 26 May; ordinary morning opening may explain the 27 May return, so a legal extension is not inferred. Humanitarian movements remain exceptions. No Brazil-frontier interval is assigned.

source_duration.Next evidence step: Seek gate logs or direct local traffic reporting to resolve first-passage clocks, bridge identity and any remaining commodity-specific restrictions.
